name: Ecare SMS
author: goecares

sections.description:
Ecare SMS is a comprehensive SMS automation plugin that integrates seamlessly with WordPress and WooCommerce. Send transactional SMS notifications, bulk messages, and manage SMS campaigns with ease.

Features:

  • Send single or bulk SMS messages
  • WooCommerce integration for order notifications
  • SMS logs and delivery tracking
  • API connection testing and balance checking
  • Secure API token encryption
  • Customizable SMS templates with placeholders
  • Support for CSV/XLSX file uploads for bulk sending
  • Admin dashboard with statistics
  • Debug mode for troubleshooting

WooCommerce Integration:

  • Automatic SMS on order placement
  • SMS notifications for order status changes
  • Custom templates for different order statuses
  • Customer phone number extraction from billing info

External services

This plugin connects to the Ecare SMS API to send SMS messages.

Service: Ecare SMS API
URL: https://send.ecaresms.com/api/v3

Data sent:

  • Phone numbers
  • Message content
  • API token

When data is sent:

  • When sending SMS (single or bulk)

Purpose:

  • To deliver SMS messages

Terms:
https://ecaresms.com/terms.html

Privacy:
https://ecaresms.com/privacy-policy.html

Privacy

This plugin stores SMS logs (recipient, message, status, API response) and optional debug data if you enable logs/debug in plugin settings. You control these features from the plugin Settings page.

Support

For support, please contact:
* WhatsApp: +8801811699722
* Email: support@ecarehost.com
* Website: https://ecare.com.bd/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ecare-sms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Ecare SMS > Settings to configure your API token and sender ID.
  4. Test the connection and start sending SMS.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API token?

Sign up at https://ecaresms.com and get your API token from the developer section.

Does it support international numbers?

Yes, the plugin supports international phone numbers in E.164 format.

Can I send SMS to multiple recipients?

Yes, you can send bulk SMS by entering multiple numbers or uploading a CSV/XLSX file.

Is WooCommerce required?

No, but WooCommerce integration provides additional features for e-commerce sites.
